items.title: The Grizzlies signing Richie Saunders means that they will have to waive one of their current two-way players: Carson Cooper, Jahmai Mashack or Javon Small.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
The Grizzlies signing Richie Saunders means that they will have to waive one of their current two-way players: Carson Cooper, Jahmai Mashack or Javon Small.

(Apologies if I missed a report of who is being waived. I've been out running errands.)

items.title: Jahmai Mashack checks in for the final defensive possession of the half and gets a steal. Arena DJ plays Public Enemy's "Shut 'Em Down." Grizz up 62-59 at the half.
